status: unverified, NOT applied in our evaluation; some coordinates derived from detector output
purpose: Errata for users of the source exports: val/test images whose exported boxes look wrong, with a suggested correction. Check each one yourself before using it.
coordinates_note: For action 'relocate', x0/x1 of the boxes were taken from the output of a trained yolo26s detector (conf >= 0.05, matched on vertical extent); only y0/y1 and the class are the original human annotation. These coordinates are detector output, not human annotation.

actions.relocate: suggested new x0/x1 for boxes that share one x-range (see coordinates_note)
actions.drop_duplicate: suggested removal of a second box on the same aircraft
actions.drop_conflict: suggested removal of a box with a conflicting class on the same aircraft
actions.exclude: no repair suggested; the image's labels look wrong

how_our_evaluation_handles_these_images: Not via this file. The clean val/test lists leave out images by label-only geometry rules (two GT boxes at IoU >= 0.5, or two GT boxes sharing one x-range) plus the leakage check; see leakage_stats.txt and build_report.json.

fields.original: label text as exported (class ids before the class merge)
